headlines.title: Oil nears $100 after Saudi Arabia says energy infrastructure was attacked
headlines.description: Brent, the international oil benchmark, touched $99 a barrel after Saudi Arabia reported an attack on energy assets that caused temporary pauses in operations.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to ban Bombardier jet sales as Canada’s retaliatory tariffs take effect
headlines.description: President Donald Trump asserted Monday that the Canadian aerospace company Bombardier should no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the United States, opening a new front in his trade war hours before new Canadian tariffs on American goods took effect.

headlines.title: Iran increases gasoline price for its heaviest consumers as economy struggles
headlines.description: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran early Tuesday introduced a higher price for its heaviest users of gasoline, state media reported, in the latest economic pinch caused by months of war.

headlines.title: Jean Chatzky on How to Plan for the 'Forever Paycheck'
headlines.description: More than half of Gen Xers are concerned about not having enough money saved for retirement, so financial expert Jean Chatzky joins TODAY to share tips from her new book, "The Forever Paycheck," for preserving wealth while still enjoying your life. She explains what the "forever paycheck" is and details the process for implementing it into your finances.

headlines.title: Why the End of Summer is the Best Time to Book a Cruise
headlines.description: As the summer crowds fade, cruise fares drop — making it the perfect time to book a sea voyage and save. NBC’s Allie Canal joins TODAY with some of the best offers out there and shares tips to add to the savings, including being flexible with dates, opting for shorter 3-day cruises and more.

headlines.title: Labor Day Sales Guide 2026: What to Buy and Where to Buy It
headlines.description: The long Labor Day holiday weekend means nabbing some pretty big deals. NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY with where to shop and what to buy, including mattresses, grills, and more. She also shares tips for saving the most you can by using browser extensions, price tracking tools, and loyalty programs.

headlines.title: How the Iran War is Driving Up Everyday American Costs
headlines.description: As the war between the United States and Iran ramps up again, it continues to have a major impact on American's wallets with rising oil prices, interest rates and more. NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to break down what it means for everyday expenses and global bond rates.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Five dead after Amazon cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport
headlines.description: Multiple people were also taken to hospitals with unknown injuries, the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office said.

headlines.title: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer says she was not fired from Fox News
headlines.description: Maria Bartiromo’s lawyer on Friday said that the Fox News and Fox Business anchor was not fired from the company where she worked for more than 12 years.

headlines.title: U.S. added 162,000 jobs in August, but wage growth continues to lag inflation
headlines.description: U.S. added 162,000 jobs in August, while wage growth continued to lag inflation

headlines.title: Price of diesel hits all-time high as Iran, Ukraine wars constrict global supply
headlines.description: For U.S. consumers, the rising cost of diesel is likely to result in higher retail prices for everything from produce and toys to lumber and apparel.
